svg.title: Trainers' Yard — Six-class practice ring
svg.desc: Six distinct stations sit around an open sparring court. Crates, balance beams and climb ropes form an optional loop above safe instruction space. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops
